judgment_calls.topic: Complicated pyelonephritis in the priority rule
judgment_calls.decision: Criteria written out in the priority rule instead of (active_condition Acute pyelonephritis), because the non-urgent uncomplicated rule diagnoses the same concept and would make every pyelonephritis urgent.
Evidence is flank pain with leucocytes/nitrites only; complicating factors not negated, so it also fires in complicated cases (same concept, same diagnosis).
Simple UTI → Lower urinary tract infectious disease; complicated UTI → Urinary tract infectious disease; MUS → Urethritis; complicated/uncomplicated pyelonephritis → Acute pyelonephritis.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Acute cystitis for simple UTI; leave unencoded.

judgment_calls.alternatives: Fire on discharge / prostate signs alone.
